text: We are now. <break time="0.8s" /> At a point of unprecedented genetic, cultural, and environmental power. <break time="0.8s" /> As a species. <break time="0.8s" /> And we are linked to nearly every other person on Earth. <break time="0.8s" /> We are embodied individuals trapped within limited time. <break time="0.8s" /> But we are also networked data streams, memories, and influencers. <break time="0.8s" /> And part of a grander humanity. <break time="0.8s" /> Our decisions today have far reaching impacts. <break time="0.8s" /> That place a responsibility on us to become good ancestors. <break time="0.8s" /> To take the long view. <break time="0.8s" /> And time travel forward. <break time="0.8s" /> To imagine the well being of billions of people. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose lives will be lived. <break time="0.8s" /> In the world we are currently making. <break time="0.8s" /> Centuries ago. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaders of the native North American Iroquois people. <break time="0.8s" /> Created seven generation stewardship. <break time="0.8s" /> Instructing people. <break time="0.8s" /> To consider the impact of every decision on their children. <break time="0.8s" /> Seven generations into the future. <break time="0.8s" /> In the precious few decades that Earth is ours. <break time="0.8s" /> While we enjoy the gardens planted by our ancestors. <break time="0.8s" /> We must not steal the shade. <break time="0.8s" /> From our descendants.
